# Image resize handling excludes links and waits for incomplete images

The accepted resize actor considers only images carrying shrinktofit or overflowing state, skips ancestors with href, and uses a once-only load listener for incomplete images. Initial message adjustment has the same link exclusion. This prevents the zoom handler from taking ownership of linked images in this path and avoids reading intrinsic dimensions before load. Preserve those checks within this image family; it does not establish readiness for CSS background images or prove every broken image loads. No delayed-image, link activation or layout test was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: Message image resize ownership.
